text:
maria: Drafting internal release note for EU window tonight 02:00-04:00 UTC. Need pin target + rollback owner. @ajay can you take rollback?
ajay: I can. Confirm commit hash and pin target (v3.2.1 stable or v3.3-rc). Also staged or full rollout?
maria: Pin to v3.2.1. Commit 0a1b2c3d. Draft snippet:
- Perf: improved token batching (~15% median).
- Fix: gateway retries caused duplicate logs (workaround: recycle sidecar pod).
- Risk: Canary cohort may see transient 502 errors for a small fraction of requests.
sophie: Copy: use 'Canary cohort' and 'recycle sidecar pod' - clearer.
leo: Add rollback bullet with exact command + owner.
ajay: I'll own rollback. Command: `deploybot rollback --to v3.2.0 --reason "502 spike"` then monitor 10m. Wait for ops-oncall go.
deploybot: Scheduled: canary v3.2.1 at 2025-06-18T02:15:00Z, 20m window. Will ping @ops-oncall at 10m.
ops-oncall: Monitoring. Trigger: 502 rate >1% for 5m or error surge >2x baseline -> call for rollback.
maria: Added 'No API changes' line per legal. Final draft locked in 30m unless objections.
